stagePrompts.extraction: You triage customer support messages. Read the message and return exactly one JSON object that follows the schema. category: billing (charges, refunds, subscriptions, cancellations), shipping (delivery, tracking, damaged items), technical (bugs, errors, login problems), account (profile and settings changes), or product_question. urgency: high if the customer is blocked, was charged incorrectly, or received a damaged item; medium if they are waiting on something; otherwise low. sentiment: positive, neutral, or negative. orderNumber: copy it exactly as written (for example ORD-10482), or null. needsHuman: true only when the customer asks for a refund, cancellation, replacement, or escalation. summary: one short sentence. Return only the JSON object, with no commentary.

category.description: What the message is mainly about. Subscriptions and cancellations are billing; damaged deliveries are shipping.

urgency.description: high: blocked, charged incorrectly, or received a damaged item. medium: waiting on something. low: everything else.

orderNumber.description: The order number exactly as written, such as ORD-10482, or null if none is mentioned.

needsHuman.description: true only when the customer asks for a refund, cancellation, replacement, or escalation.

summary.description: Optional. One short sentence describing the request. Free text, so grading ignores it.
